evals.name: counterexample-to-test
evals.prompt: verification/SpanCapture/SpanCapture/Findings.lean proves preFix_staleRelease_strands: before the fix, disposing capture 1 strands a span of capture 2. Write the MSTest test that reproduces it on the real collector.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. A LeanTest.MSTest test in ArchCheck.Spans.Tests with [TestScenarioId("SpanCapture.preFix_staleRelease_strands")] and [TestTag("SpanCapture.Spec.OpenSpansStopIntoTheirCapture")], a ContextBuilder per test over the collector's container, and every call commented with its model actions. It fails on the pre-fix Release with a timeout naming the stranded span and passes on the fixed code.

evals.name: claim-coverage
evals.prompt: Which SpanCapture Spec claims have no test yet?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Runs the Spans tests with --report-trx, then claim-coverage.cs with the four SpanCapture.Spec claims, and reports the UNCOVERED ones with a witness test proposed for each. No coverage is claimed without the script's output.

evals.name: review-leantest-class
evals.prompt: Review our LeanTest.MSTest test classes: do the scenario ids and tags reach the .trx, and can they run in parallel?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Checks RegisterAttributes in [TestInitialize], a ContextBuilder per test rather than the static ContextBuilderFactory, one exact pin for all three LeanTest packages, and ExceptionAssert hiding a message that carries the failure's reason.

evals.name: plain-mstest-negative
evals.prompt: Add an MSTest test that SpanTrace.Build returns both roots when a trace has two.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger: a plain MSTest unit test with no Lean model or LeanTest involved.
